About Senscat

Senscat is a digital service company that plans, develops, and operates services in education and AI marketing. We also accept custom software development outsourcing projects.

센스매스(Sensmath) supports middle school math learning. 센스프로모(SensePromo) helps online sellers prepare weekly product promotions with AI. We also build custom software solutions for partner companies.

We keep each service practical, stable, and respectful of personal data.

Operating Principles

  • 01 Experimentation

    We quickly test new ideas and are not afraid of failure.

  • 02 Transparency

    We transparently disclose how services operate and communicate honestly with users.

  • 03 User Respect

    We respect user choice and privacy, always prioritizing user experience.

Service Purposes

센스매스

Sensmath is an AI-based diagnostic and supplementary learning service for middle school math.

센스프로모

SensePromo is an AI marketing agent for solo sellers on Smart Store, Coupang, and Cafe24. Register your products and AI prepares this week's promotion.

센스냥(senscat)

A digital product studio that turns AI service ideas into products and improves them with operating data.
